data.title: Nasdaq 100 eyes $1.8 trillion loss as Democratic win sparks AI delay fears
data.description: Nov 5 (Reuters) - The Nasdaq 100 index was set to lose a whopping $1.8 trillion in stock value on Thursday as investors feared that the sweeping midterm victory of Democrats could stall the pace of ‌AI infrastructure expansion.
